content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About IIT (ISM) Dhanbad
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad is an institute of technology in Dhanbad. This notice comes from its Office of the Dean (Research & Development) and is for a TexMin-funded project titled "AI-Driven Process Optimization of HVAF-Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Coatings for Enhanced Erosion Resistance in Mining Applications". Prof. Ashutosh Tripathy is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice heading calls this a "Research Assistant position", while its position row names Research Associate – I (RA-I).

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Data collection from literature and reported studies Experimental rock abrasion studies Characterization of geologic materials Report preparation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and the requirements of the project. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date. Having the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an interview invitation.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The tenure of the post is 3 months. The RA will report to the principal investigators of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Research Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed resume with your photograph. Gather all relevant supporting documents regarding your age, qualification and experience. Email the resume and documents to [email protected] by the due date. Original certificates and supporting documents must be brought for verification at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. What will the Research Associate do on this project?
faq.answer: The work covers literature data collection, experimental rock abrasion studies, characterization of geologic materials and report preparation.

faq.question: Q2. Which documents must I send with my application?
faq.answer: Send a detailed resume with your photograph, along with supporting documents for your age, qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q3. Will every eligible applicant be called for an interview?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates shortlisted on merit and project requirements will be informed of the interview date.

faq.question: Q4. Will IIT (ISM) Dhanbad pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. Candidates must also make their own arrangements for any stay at Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q5. Who can I contact for more details?
faq.answer: Contact Dr. Ashutosh Tripathy, Principal Investigator, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, at [email protected].
